title: Soviet MiG-21 and MiG-19 interceptors, incl. MiG-19 photographed by a U-2, 13 October 1957
description: Page of three black-and-white photographs of Soviet jet interceptors. The caption reads "Soviet MiG-21 interceptor (top), Soviet MiG-19 interceptor (middle), Soviet MiG-19 photographed by a U-2, 13 October 1957 (bottom)." The bottom image is a dark, grainy frame showing a small aircraft silhouette below the U-2. Page is marked Secret NOFORN (struck through) with handwritten page number 150.
